title: Unit 30 Consolidation: Politics & Democracy
goal: Consolidate oratorical -ra forms, parliamentary pivots, pasar a transitions, reduplicated subjunctives, and speech markers

items: I can use formal -ra conditional forms, parliamentary contrast pivots, and pasar a transitions in civic speeches.

I can use Unit 30 politics and democracy vocabulary accurately in C1 speeches and dialogue.
